SupportBeth: FYI - Saturn filed an urgent ticket: their dedicated route in eu-central-1 just spiked tail latency; customer app seeing timeouts. Ticket SAT-4219 attached.
Oliver (PM): Thanks. Can you paste the event IDs and whether this started after any deploy? priority?
SupportBeth: Event IDs r=abc123 / r=abc124. They report p95 jumping from ~100ms to ~1s since ~00:10 UTC. Escalated to CSM.
deploy-bot: deploy-prod eu-central-1: runtime v1.23.7 rolled at 2024-11-07T00:03Z by ci/CD. Status: success
Jon (SRE): That deploy lines up. Need dashboard link, queue size, and current batch sizing for their route.
SupportBeth: Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/saturn-eu-central-latency. Model: gptx-3.1-q4-v2, pinned.
Sasha (Eng): I'm checking node-level traces. Quick question - are they using prefix cache or disabled? a cache miss storm could explain tail.
Mei (Eng-ML): Also noting we shipped a qkv kernel change last week. I'll pull kernel selection logs for their nodes.
Jon (SRE): Short-term mitigations we can consider: rollback the runtime in the region; force kernel fallback on affected hosts; reduce max_batch_size on the Saturn route. Which is least risky and fastest?
Sasha (Eng): Fastest, least blast radius = routing override to reduce max_batch_size for that customer to 4. Non-invasive, reversible. I can push config in ~20m.
Mei (Eng-ML): From initial traces, kernel_select is switching to fused-matmul-v2 intermittently where optimized-fused-qkv should be picked for q4 models. Looks like a CPU feature detection edge-case after the runtime change.
Jon (SRE): I'll prepare rollback steps but agree we should try routing override first. If that doesn't restore p95 <200ms, we escalate to rollback.
SupportBeth: Notifying Saturn: we'll apply a temporary routing change to reduce tail latency and follow up with RCA and timeline.
Oliver (PM): Please confirm acceptance criteria to close this intake: sustained p95 <200ms for 30m, no spike in errors, and an internal RCA with a proposed fix within 72 hours.
Sasha (Eng): Action list: Sasha -> apply route override (15-25m), Jon -> monitor and prep rollback runbook, Mei -> begin kernel selection RCA and PR, SupportBeth -> customer comms, Oliver -> prioritize follow-up in next sprint if code change needed.
Jon (SRE): Applying override now: PATCH /routes/saturn {"max_batch_size":4, "region_override":"eu-central-1"} 
deploy-bot: route-config-update: /routes/saturn -> success (eu-central-1)
Jon (SRE): Monitoring: p95 dropped to ~170ms within 12 minutes. queue depth and queue latency improved.
SupportBeth: Saturn acknowledges the temporary fix and reports improved responsiveness. They've asked for timeline and whether this could recur.
Mei (Eng-ML): For the long-term fix I'll add a CPU blacklist for the faulty feature-detect path and add unit tests to kernel selector. Target PR in ~48 hours; request canary rollout to staging then to a low-traffic region.
Sasha (Eng): Filed INF-6789 with traces, repro steps, and a minimal reproducer for seq_len ~512 + batch >8. Linking to the ticket.
SalesAlex: Saturn is on reserved capacity with p95 SLA. I've told CSM we have a mitigation and will provide incident summary + credit if SLA breached. Keep me posted for customer communications.
Oliver (PM): Thanks team. Closing intake: convert INF-6789 into a P0 backlog item with the acceptance criteria above. Reopen if metrics regress.
SupportBeth: Will monitor and update the customer; will reopen ticket if anything changes.
